name: moonbag-server
description: MOONBAG backend: reads Streamflow locks and distributes pump.fun creator rewards to lockers every round

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:reset && npm run test:streamflow
scripts.test:streamflow: DB_PATH=test-streamflow.db tsx src/test-streamflow.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-streamflow.db*; exit $s
scripts.test:reset: DB_PATH=test-reset.db tsx src/test-reset.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-reset.db*; exit $s
scripts.test:fuzz: DB_PATH=test-fuzz.db tsx src/test-fuzz.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-fuzz.db*; exit $s
scripts.test:engine: DB_PATH=test-suite.db tsx src/test-suite.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-suite.db*; exit $s
